# glitchtip Provider

Manages resources on a GlitchTip instance's REST API (`/api/0/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    glitchtip = {
      source = "nmehlei/glitchtip"
    }
  }
}

provider "glitchtip" {
  endpoint = "https://app.glitchtip.com"
  # token is sensitive - prefer the GLITCHTIP_TOKEN environment variable.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the GlitchTip instance. Defaults to `https://app.glitchtip.com` (the hosted SaaS); override for a self-hosted instance, e.g. `https://glitchtip.example.com`.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Allow a plain-HTTP endpoint. Only for local development against a disposable instance - never set this against a production endpoint.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer auth token for the GlitchTip API. Falls back to the `GLITCHTIP_TOKEN` environment variable when unset; configuration fails if neither is present.
